verdict.rationale: PowerShell wrote a command handler under HKU\...\mscfile\shell\open\command, then launched eventvwr.exe, which auto-elevates and spawned a High-integrity PowerShell child. This is the known eventvwr.exe UAC bypass hijack, and the process access to eventvwr.exe with full rights (0x1fffff) supports it.
